Hensel Phelps Construction activity over recent fiscal years shows varying annual totals: FY21 $100M, FY22 $291M, FY23 $55.8M, FY24 $500M, FY25 $47.5M, and FY26 $427M. Hensel Phelps Construction current-year totals are partial because the period is fiscal year to date. Hensel Phelps Construction award-count and average-award metrics reflect the current mix of obligations rather than total contract values in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables. Hensel Phelps Construction saw a large swing between FY25 and FY26, following a much larger total in FY24. Hensel Phelps Construction figures reported here are contract obligations unless an item is explicitly described as an award-value or total contract value.
